factcheck.claim: Otter.ai Basic (free): 300 monthly transcription minutes, 30-minute cap per conversation, 3 lifetime file imports; a longer import is not stopped but only the first 30 minutes of transcript are accessible until upgrade (as of Oct 2026)
Rev free plan: 45 AI transcription minutes/month; human transcription $1.99/min
Sonix: 30 free minutes for new accounts (no card), pay-as-you-go $10/hour; SOC 2 Type II listed

Word Transcribe: Microsoft 365 subscribers get 300 minutes/month of uploaded audio; speakers labelled Speaker 1, Speaker 2 and renameable; desktop version requires optional connected experiences, which admins can disable by policy, so availability depends on license and admin settings
noScribe is free/open source (GPL-3.0), runs completely locally, uses Whisper/faster-whisper and pyannote speaker detection, Windows/macOS/Linux
Otter's privacy policy states it trains its proprietary AI on de-identified audio recordings and on transcriptions that may contain personal information
Trint: never listens to recordings to train algorithms; ISO 27001 certified

MacWhisper transcribes on-device by default; Pro speaker recognition works on local WhisperKit models (built for Apple Silicon) or cloud providers ElevenLabs/Deepgram; optional cloud transcription and ChatGPT (OpenAI API key) features send data off-device; mixed-language audio can produce garbled output

UMBC: many transcription services retain access to recordings; outside transcriptionists must sign a confidentiality agreement before transcribing, kept in the investigator's protocol file. UF ECE: Otter free plan not approved, Business/Pro with UF email only, no sensitive research data
Bentley UXC kept its own notes and used Otter transcripts to fill gaps in them via timestamps; transcripts were not a final record and not accurate enough to share with a client unreviewed
NVivo Transcription is an online (cloud) service: audio is uploaded to the vendor's online platform; University of York approves it only for anonymised data
Otter Pro (as of Oct 2026): $16.99/month monthly or $8.33/month billed annually, 90-minute cap per conversation, 10 imports/month; 20% student/teacher discount for .edu emails

quotes.text: It runs completely locally on your computer, protecting the confidentiality of your interviews.

variables.headline_finding: Otter's '300 free minutes' covers at most 3 uploaded interviews ever (3 lifetime imports + 30-min cap per conversation); Rev free (45 min) covers less than one 1-hour interview
variables.free_tier_math: One-hour interviews covered per month: Word Transcribe ~5 (300 min, M365), Otter Basic ≤3 lifetime imports, Rev 0 full, Sonix 30 min once, noScribe unlimited (local)
variables.training_policy_matrix: Per-vendor statement on training with user content: Otter trains on de-identified audio+transcripts; Trint says never listens to recordings for training; Sonix pricing page silent; local tools upload nothing
variables.institutional_rules: UF ECE bars Otter free plan; UMBC requires signed confidentiality agreements and warns most services retain access
variables.decision_flow: Original decision graphic: sensitive data → local tool; non-sensitive + university-approved cloud → Word Transcribe; otherwise IRB sign-off before Otter/Rev/Sonix/Trint
